citation.title: Effects of acute combined exercise on cognitive function in sedentary men (Stroop Color and Word Test after combined, resistance and sitting sessions)

reported.what: sitting control session blood lactate, pre-session and approximately 20 min after initiation, mean (SD), n=15 men; no food before the visit is stated, so a resting lactate has no meal or fast to be entered under

location.where: Table 3, SC rows 'Pre exercise' and 'During exercise', Lactate (mmol/L) column

reported.what: sitting control session heart rate pre-session, during and post-session, mean (SD), n=15; HR was recorded continually but the pre value has no stated run-in and the during/post values have no stated window

location.where: Table 3, SC rows, Heart Rate (bpm) column

detail: The only enterable-looking numbers are the sitting-control lactate (pre and about 20 min) and heart rate of 15 men. The paper says nothing about food before the sessions (only 8 am to 12 pm, no caffeine, alcohol, ergogenic aids or strenuous exercise for 24 h), so the fed state is unknown and resting lactate cannot be entered as fasted or as fed; the model could not be told which. Resting heart rate is meal-independent but the pre value sits at the arm start with no printed run-in (the 5 min seated rest in the Methods belongs to the ergometer set-up, not to the sessions), and the during/post values carry no printed minute or averaging window. The exercise sessions have no whole-body intensity for the upper-body resistance part and no printed minute for post-session samples.
